blocks.text: Managing your inbox as a tax advisor

Your inbox is the central hub for tax season. Clients send documents, ask questions, and request meetings. Without a system, you lose hours to manual sorting. Start by using folders to categorize client types or tax years. You can create a folder in Outlook for Mac by right-clicking your inbox and selecting New Folder. Use this for specific projects like 2026 Tax Filings or Quarterly Estimates.

Searching for specific documents is often where tax advisors lose time. Use the search bar at the top of the window to find emails from specific clients. You can refine your search by using filters like From, Subject, or Has Attachments. If you struggle to locate files, ask Lazur to point out the search filter options on your screen. This keeps your hands on the keyboard and your eyes on the data.
Faster with Lazur

Lazur works with your existing apps. It does not replace Outlook. Instead, it helps you move faster. When you have a question about a setting, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask. Lazur reads your screen and gives you the answer. If you need to find a hidden menu, ask Lazur to point it out. It draws a circle around the button so you do not have to hunt for it.
Outlook for Mac keyboard shortcuts

Speed comes from not using the mouse. Learn these core shortcuts to navigate Outlook for Mac. Use ⌘ 1 to jump to your Mail. Use ⌘ 2 for your Calendar. Use ⌘ 3 to see your Contacts. These simple changes save seconds every time you switch views. Over a day, these seconds add up to minutes of saved time.

items: Save your current email draft: ⌘ S

blocks.text: If you want to create your own shortcuts, go to System Settings > Keyboard > Keyboard Shortcuts > App Shortcuts. Click the plus button to add a new one. Enter the menu command exactly as it appears in the Outlook menu bar. This is useful for commands you use often but lack a default shortcut.
Automating client scheduling

Scheduling meetings is a major source of email back and forth. Stop the cycle by sharing your calendar availability. You can share your calendar in Outlook for Mac by right-clicking your calendar name and selecting Sharing Permissions. This allows clients to see when you are free without asking you directly. If you manage multiple calendars, learn how to change your default calendar in Outlook for Mac to ensure invites go to the right place.

When you need to send a meeting invite, use ⌘ N while in the Calendar view. Fill in the details and send it. If you find the interface confusing, ask Lazur to explain the steps to send a meeting invite in Outlook. It will walk you through the process one step at a time.
Security and updates for tax advisors

Tax data is sensitive. You must keep your apps updated. Microsoft requires macOS 14 or later to receive security updates for Outlook. Check your macOS version in the Apple menu > About This Mac. If you are on an older system, update as soon as possible. This protects your client information from vulnerabilities.

Legacy Outlook for Mac support for Exchange Online mailboxes is scheduled to end in October 2026. Ensure you have transitioned to the New Outlook experience before this date to avoid connection issues.
blocks.title: Important deadline

blocks.text: If you experience sync errors like -3253, check your internet connection first. If the error persists, remove and re-add your account. You can learn how to add an email account in Outlook for Mac through the official support pages. Keep your server settings handy to ensure a smooth reconnection.
Common mistakes to avoid

items: Ignoring the New Outlook interface: You will lose access to updates if you stay on the legacy version.
Not using folders: A cluttered inbox makes it hard to find client documents quickly.
Manual scheduling: Sending multiple emails to find a meeting time wastes your billable hours.
Missing keyboard shortcuts: Relying on the mouse slows down your daily workflow.
Delaying macOS updates: Running outdated software puts your client data at risk.

blocks.text: Using Lazur to draft emails

Drafting emails takes up much of your day. You can use Lazur to dictate clean text. Hold the fn key and start speaking. Lazur formats the text for you. This is useful for quick status updates or follow-up notes. You can also use clipboard slots to store common phrases like your meeting booking link or tax filing instructions.

Lazur keeps a memory of what you asked. If you need to draft a similar email for another client, you can reference your previous request. This keeps your communication consistent. It also helps you avoid repetitive typing. Use this to maintain your professional tone without spending extra time on every single message.
Staying organized with tasks and reminders

Tax advisors have many deadlines. Use the built-in task features in Outlook to track them. You can set a reminder for an email in Outlook for Mac to ensure you follow up at the right time. Right-click the email and select Follow Up to set a date. This prevents important client requests from getting buried in your inbox.

If you have a large volume of emails, use the pin feature. You can pin an email in Outlook for Mac to keep it at the top of your list. This is great for emails that require immediate action or are part of a current tax project. Once you finish the task, unpin it to keep your workspace clean.
Optimizing your display

The way your inbox looks impacts your efficiency. You can turn off Focused Inbox in Outlook for Mac if you prefer to see all your emails in one list. Go to View > Focused Inbox to toggle it. Some advisors prefer this to ensure they do not miss any client correspondence. You can also change the default font in Outlook for Mac to make your emails easier to read. Go to Outlook > Settings > Fonts to adjust your preferences.

If you manage a shared mailbox for your firm, you can add it to your main view. Learn how to add a shared mailbox in Outlook for Mac to keep all your firm's communication in one place. This allows you to monitor client inquiries even when you are not the primary contact. It is a great way to ensure no client is left waiting for a response.

faq.question: Can Lazur click buttons in Outlook for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur is a voice assistant that points, explains, and guides. It helps you find buttons and learn how to use features, but it does not perform clicks or operate the app for you.

faq.question: Does Lazur store my email content?
faq.answer: No. Lazur only sees your screen and listens to your voice while you hold the shortcut. The data is sent to AI providers to answer your question and is not stored or used to train models.

faq.question: Is Outlook for Mac free?
faq.answer: Outlook for Mac is part of the Microsoft 365 subscription. You need a valid subscription to receive updates and access all features.

faq.question: What should I do if my Outlook sync fails?
faq.answer: Check your internet connection first. If it persists, try removing and re-adding your account. Ensure you are using the latest version of the app from the Mac App Store.
